source_metadata_lines: This file was created by CMPT_ME_PRIOR_RETS using the 201705 CRSP database.  It | contains a momentum factor, constructed from six value-weight portfolios formed | using independent sorts on size and prior return of NYSE, AMEX, and NASDAQ stocks. | Mom    is the average of the returns on two (big and small) high prior return portfolios | minus the average of the returns on two low prior return portfolios.  The portfolios | are constructed monthly.  Big means a firm is above the median market cap on the NYSE | at the end of the previous month; small firms are below the median NYSE market cap. | Prior return is measured from month -12 to - 2.  Firms in the low prior return | portfolio are below the 30th NYSE percentile.  Those in the high portfolio are above | the 70th NYSE percentile. | Missing data are indicated by -99.99 or -999.
